content: Excuse me? I think you are in my seat. Look, it says 9B on my boarding card.
Sorry, but could we exchange seats? This is my old friend. We haven't seen each other for a long time. I really want to sit next to him.
In that case you can sit here, but where is your seat?
Oh, that's great. I asked for a window seat. But there were not any left. I really didn't expect I'd get one this way. Thank you.
